title: Border's Finite Auction Feasibility Theorem
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: For arbitrary finite bidders with heterogeneous finite type spaces, a nonnegative normalized real joint prior, and an interim allocation rule with values in [0,1], a randomized allocation of at most one item realizes the weighted interim masses if and only if every collection of bidder-specific type subsets satisfies Border's union-probability inequality. Weighted feasibility is proved equivalent to conditional feasibility on positive marginal support. Null-type interim values remain unrestricted within [0,1].
